correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the source definitions and all normalizations. Permutation symmetry yields <a1/E>=1/n and <a1^2/E>+(n-1)<a1 a2/E>=1; combining these with c(0)-d(0)=< (a1-a2)^2/E >/2 and sin^2(p1)=a1(2-a1) gives the dimension-wide identity exactly. In n=2 the q-integral and two elementary substitutions give s(0)=1-2/pi, from which both couplings and the hyperbola intersections follow. Numerical replay only corroborates the exact derivation.

value.rationale: The two constants are the vertical transition lines that organize the source spectral phase diagram, and A,B are named landmark points on its threshold hyperbola. The result converts those structural boundaries from unevaluated torus integrals to exact closed forms and proves they satisfy one identity in every dimension n>=2. This is a natural phase-diagram invariant, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a mere numerical recomputation.
